description:
Manage your product feeds directly from ChatGPT. Connect your account to inspect sources, feeds, products, attribute mappings, and change history without opening the platform.

Run feed audits to catch data quality issues before they reach channels like Google Shopping, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Shopping, TikTok, Pinterest, and ChatGPT Ads, plus 3,500+ other channels.

Review Google Merchant Center diagnostics, search and block individual items, and force a sync when you need changes live immediately. You can also get step-by-step guidance on feed setup, optimization, and A/B testing, from mapping attributes and improving product titles to running experiments on any feed attribute and letting performance data pick the winner.

Built for merchants, agencies, and digital marketing specialists who want to check, fix, and optimize their shopping feeds as part of a conversation.

defaultPrompt: Explain the rules for custom labels in Google feed
Check GMC for any feed errors
